name: shots/missile
description: Ground missile with a flickering exhaust, v2 (w15-PIXMAP1, art bible v2 § 5.3): the v1 missile redrawn at 12 × 5 — tail fins on the outline rows, a two-pixel nozzle, a three-step tapered exhaust flame and a white nose shoulder capped in outline dark — on v1's palette and its core-line grammar.
